sentences.en: In an incident, the `mark_verified` tool executed and the human reviewer explicitly rejected the ID, but due to a software bug the `is_verified` flag was incorrectly set to `true`.
장애 분석 에이전트에 `search_incidents` MCP 도구(설명: "Search incidents.")를 붙였다. 그런데 에이전트는 계속 Bash로 로컬 로그 파일만 grep한다. 먼저 해야 할 조치는?
An architect is asked to design an agent that investigates why a production incident occurred, given only a vague alert message and no prior knowledge of which service is at fault.
